items.example: She took the initiative and organised the whole trip.
items.exampleTr: İnisiyatif alıp tüm geziyi o organize etti.
items.simple: You start doing something yourself, and no one needs to tell you.

items.example: Several parents voiced concerns about the new schedule.
items.exampleTr: Birkaç veli yeni programla ilgili endişelerini dile getirdi.
items.simple: You say out loud what worries you.

items.example: I don't bear a grudge. It's all in the past.
items.exampleTr: Kin beslemem. Hepsi geçmişte kaldı.
items.simple: You stay angry at a person for something they did long ago.

items.example: After two hours, we finally reached a consensus.
items.exampleTr: İki saat sonra nihayet fikir birliğine vardık.
items.simple: After talking, everyone agrees on the same idea.

items.example: We need to draw a distinction between the two issues.
items.exampleTr: İki konu arasında ayrım yapmamız gerekiyor.
items.simple: You say clearly how two things are not the same.

items.example: The report sheds light on what really happened.
items.exampleTr: Rapor gerçekte ne olduğuna ışık tutuyor.
items.simple: You help people understand something that was hard to see.

items.example: If we let him do it, we'll set a precedent.
items.exampleTr: Buna izin verirsek emsal oluştururuz.
items.simple: You do something new that others will copy later as a rule.

items.example: It takes time to foster a good relationship with clients.
items.exampleTr: Müşterilerle iyi bir ilişki geliştirmek zaman alır.
items.simple: You help a friendship grow stronger with time.

items.example: This course helps bridge the gap between school and work.
items.exampleTr: Bu kurs okul ile iş arasındaki farkı kapatmaya yardım ediyor.
items.simple: You make two far-apart things come closer.

items.example: The article sparked a heated debate online.
items.exampleTr: Makale internette hararetli bir tartışma başlattı.
items.simple: Something makes many people start talking about it.

items.example: The city imposed a restriction on night parking.
items.exampleTr: Şehir gece parkına kısıtlama getirdi.
items.simple: Someone with power makes a new rule that says you cannot do something.

items.example: We need to tackle this problem head-on.
items.exampleTr: Bu sorunu doğrudan ele almamız gerek.
items.simple: You start to work on a hard thing to fix it.

items.example: Don't be shy. Seize the opportunity while you can.
items.exampleTr: Utanma. Elinden geliyorken fırsatı değerlendir.
items.simple: You grab a good chance quickly, before it goes.

items.example: Take your time and weigh your options carefully.
items.exampleTr: Acele etme ve seçeneklerini dikkatle tart.
items.simple: You think about each choice, good and bad, before you pick.

items.example: I'm going to lodge a complaint with the manager.
items.exampleTr: Müdüre şikayette bulunacağım.
items.simple: You tell someone in charge, officially, that something was wrong.

items.example: If you don't back up your files, you run a risk.
items.exampleTr: Dosyalarını yedeklemezsen risk alırsın.
items.simple: You do something that could go badly.

items.example: I've been racking my brains, but I can't remember her name.
items.exampleTr: Kafa patlatıyorum ama adını hatırlayamıyorum.
items.simple: You think very, very hard to remember or find something.

items.example: Now we can finally reap the benefits of all that work.
items.exampleTr: Artık tüm o emeğin meyvelerini sonunda toplayabiliriz.
items.simple: After working hard, you get the good things that come from it.

items.example: Years of night shifts have taken a toll on his health.
items.exampleTr: Yıllarca süren gece vardiyaları sağlığını yıprattı.
items.simple: Something slowly makes you weaker or more tired.

items.example: You made your choice, so now face the consequences.
items.exampleTr: Seçimini yaptın, şimdi sonuçlarına katlan.
items.simple: You must accept the bad things that happen because of what you did.

items.tr: telafi etmek, barışmak için bir şey yapmak
items.example: He sent flowers to make amends for his mistake.
items.exampleTr: Hatasını telafi etmek için çiçek gönderdi.
items.simple: You do something nice to fix a wrong you did.

items.example: She wields a lot of influence in the company.
items.exampleTr: Şirkette çok nüfuzu var.
items.simple: You have power, and people listen to you and follow you.

items.example: I tried to remember the name, but I drew a blank.
items.exampleTr: İsmi hatırlamaya çalıştım ama aklıma hiçbir şey gelmedi.
items.simple: You try to remember, but nothing comes to your mind.
